stance: Inflation pipeline is heating. September PPI headline rose 1.3% m/m (6.3% y/y) and core 0.7% m/m (5.0% y/y), accelerating from 0.5% and 0.2% in August. Energy drove much of the headline, but core broadening matters more for the Fed. PPI leads CPI by 1 to 3 months, so expect upside CPI risk. No core PCE data in view yet. A reversal in energy and core m/m back near 0.3% would soften this view.
